name: digital-mv-csms
description: Digital MV Customer Service Management System

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,cyan "npm run dev -w @mv/api" "npm run dev -w @mv/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @mv/api && npm run build -w @mv/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @mv/shared && npm run typecheck -w @mv/api && npm run typecheck -w @mv/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @mv/shared && npm run test -w @mv/api && npm run test -w @mv/web
